Registration as a Beekeeper

Anyone who owns one or more hives of bees in Victoria is required by law to register as a beekeeper with the Department of Agriculture.

Registration is free for up to 5 hives.

Go to https://bees.agriculture.vic.gov.au/Home/Registration
